nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf storing token balances.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance storing spend approvals.
Private owner address set to deployer; used for privileged access checks.
Public uint totalSupply of the ANDR token set in constructor.
Payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable transferFrom guarded by ensure modifier; mutates balanceOf and allowance with unchecked arithmetic.
Payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
Privileged function performing a delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only batch distribution looping over an array and mutating balances with unchecked multiplication.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap V2 pair address via keccak256 of factory and token hashes.
Modifier that computes the UNI pair address and restricts callers to owner or the pair address.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, supply, owner balances and infinite UNI allowance.
msg.sender is attacker-controlled and drives authorization and balance mutations.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary code in the context of this contract, risking full state takeover.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend can overflow.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom can underflow.
Parameter _to of transfer, the recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer, the amount to send.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the source address.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the recipient address.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, the amount moved and subtracted from allowance.
Parameter _spender of approve, the address granted allowance.
Parameter _value of approve, the allowance amount set.
Parameter a of delegate, the target address for the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate, the arbitrary calldata for the delegatecall.
Parameter _tos of batchSend, the array of recipients whose length multiplies _value.
Parameter _value of batchSend, amount sent to each recipient.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, subject to overflow.
Loop counter i in batchSend.
Loop-local _to address in batchSend receiving increments.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument into transferFrom inside transfer.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used to decrement allowance[_from][msg.sender].
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing an arbitrary delegatecall.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and credits/debits msg.sender balances.
transfer calls transferFrom to perform the actual state update.
transfer indirectly reads and writes balanceOf through transferFrom.
transfer indirectly touches allowance through transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
batchSend mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and each balanceOf[_to].
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
constructor assigns totalSupply = _supply.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall guarded only by msg.sender == owner.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, enabling overflow.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance subtraction enabling underflow.
ensure modifier gates execution of transferFrom on owner or UNI pair.
ensure reads owner to authorize _from or _to.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the UNI pair address for the check.
_to parameter flows into transfer as recipient.
_value parameter flows into transfer as amount.
_from parameter flows into transferFrom source checks.
_to parameter flows into transferFrom recipient balance credit.
_value parameter drives unchecked allowance and balance subtraction.
_spender parameter flows into approve allowance key.
_value parameter flows into approve allowance amount.
address a parameter becomes the delegatecall target.
bytes b parameter becomes the delegatecall calldata.
_tos array length multiplies _value, driving overflow risk.
_value parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication and credits.
local total holds the overflow-prone product _value * _tos.length.
loop index i controls iteration in batchSend.
loop-local _to receives balance increments in batchSend.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of transfer.
_value is only meaningful as the amount argument of transfer.
_from is a transient parameter of transferFrom.
_to is a transient parameter of transferFrom.
_value is a transient parameter feedng the unsafe subtraction.
_spender is a transient allowance key parameter of approve.
_value is a transient allowance amount parameter of approve.
address a is only the delegatecall target within delegate.
bytes b is only the delegatecall calldata within delegate.
_tos is only consumed by the batchSend loop.
_value is only consumed as the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
local total is exactly the result of the unsafe multiplication.
loop counter i only exists inside batchSend.
loop-local _to only exists inside the batchSend loop.
